items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We played for a -- a guy named Mike Hall, a millionaire, in Texas -- parties for him

ctx.x: down at Bryant, Texas. We played the proms for them, we played at -- at University of Texas at -- University of Texas at Austin, Texas. We opened in Texas -- we opened the new Athletic Building there, I think it was a big gym house there, the first time they ever had an affair in there, our band played for it. That's been years ago. It was a brand new building then, I remember.

We played Orange, Texas, at the countryclub there, we played at various countryclubs. We played for a -- a guy named Mike Hall, a millionaire, in Texas -- parties for him and we played at this big hotel in Houston, can't think of the name of it now, it'll come to me, and the Mexican waiters didn't want to wait on us. And this man cursed the waiters out and told them if they wanted a job they'd better come on and wait on us, and so they served us right in the hotel dining room with his guests, only we had a…

We played at the Dallas -- I mean at the Houston Countryclub. For parties of -- I guess about 10 couples, people had been flown in from -- and that was something new then, from New York and different places, for this party, 10 or 12 couples. I remember, first time I'd ever seen this, a woman just walked up with her evening gown and jump in the pool, you know what I mean? It was quite exciting, you know, to see and play parties like this.
